text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup, where the world's 
strongest contenders gathered, Tokai Teio 
seized a brilliant victory.

The next day, Tokai Teio headed to the 
student council room to meet with Symboli 
Rudolf.

When Tokai Teio visits the Student Council 
room, Symboli Rudolf wishes to test her 
mettle against the now fully matured 
"Emperor."

The stage of the contest is the year-end 
grand finale... The Arima Kinen! The 
showdown Tokai Teio so desperately desired 
is finally about to happen!
